title: RIP FSLTL: The End of Free Live Traffic (Do THIS Instead)
description:
The MSFS world just changed forever. As of April 30th, 2026, the FSLTL live traffic data feed has officially gone dark. If you’ve noticed your airports looking like ghost towns, you aren't alone—the FSLTL shutdown means we need new ways to get realistic AI traffic in MSFS 2024.  

In this comprehensive 2026 AI Traffic Guide, I’m breaking down the 5 best alternatives to FSLTL to ensure your Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 experience remains as immersive as possible. We aren't just looking at "replacements"; we’re looking at significant upgrades in flight sim realism and AI traffic injection.

Why FSLTL changed and what it means for you:

- While the FSLTL models remain the gold standard for VATSIM and IVAO users, the loss of the free FlightRadar24 API means "set it and forget it" live traffic needs a new home. We dive deep into:
- The "Old Reliable": Why AIG (Alpha India Group) is still the best free MSFS traffic option if you have the storage space for the AIG AI Manager.
- The Pro Setup: How PSXT + RealTraffic provides the most accurate gate-to-gate realism using real-time raw data.
- The New Era: How BeyondATC and SayIntentions.AI are revolutionizing AI ATC and traffic flow to prevent "go-arounds" and SimConnect stutters.
- Xbox & Casual: Looking at BravoAirspace ATG for a plug-and-play solution.
